text: Projeto inicializado por demerzel init em 2026-10-07

ABBA Android run 37609765062 (PR #26): PROBE-BG stream=on-at-spawn (custo do driver proprietário); P3/P4/P5 PASS, P2 tap +1.2ms NOT PASSED, P6 inconclusivo, P11 FAIL settle:false (35-45% vazios); device-test 3d fling D1 falhou (491 vs 384)

Revisão ABBA 37609765062: P5 é vitória de stack neste CI, não do driver (57% guest 2x mais lento sob stack OFF, 17% algoritmo await, <1% tools). Causa do 2x não isolada: faltam arms ON-im+simserver-idle e await cruzado. Deltas CPU da probe = ruído.

settle:true = waitForIdle(500) cap fixo, nunca vê tela quieta (50/51 timeout). P11 vazio ON não é regressão: describe cai dentro da transição (frame 250ms antes). Arquitetura: settle vai para a ação (settleAfterAction); describe imediato + retry em 0 elementos.

step describe-retry-empty commitado: Android describe: re-read up to 2x 50 ms apart when the open server returns a root with 0 elements, hint on a 0-element root, docs say settle is a waitForIdle(500) cap

step ios-siminput-send-queue commitado: iOS-4 ticket 3: sim-input runs latency-critical, frames paced on a monotonic deadline, serial send queue with per-message timing on the ack; host-side hold 50 ms measures 50-60 ms, 12 swipe frames at 20 ms land in 240-290 ms

siminput-registry-route deve: conciliar ack com PR #23 (bloco timing), trocar .userInitiated por .userInitiatedAllowingIdleSystemSleep, fazer o selftest exercitar tap/swipe reais (offsets em função pura), usleep restante em key/button/text

step mcp-use-device adjudicado accept por fable:coordinator: Round 3 passed with one docs note (serial), fixed inline; rounds 1-2 each found one real major (optional-key injection, learn-before-forget on stop) and both are fixed and covered by handler tests; verify green, docs…

step mcp-use-device commitado: argent-mcp: per-session default device (use-device tool, learned from boot-device/any id), device id optional in the exposed schema and injected when missing, list-devices marks the default; docs
step run-on-devices commitado: run-on-devices {udids[], steps[], screenshots}: run-sequence fan-out per device with Promise.allSettled, serialised per device by device-mutex, per-device results; docs
